findings.where: First screen, the contact row: the filled blue 'Write to me' button and the underlined address 'Mark.Moseley@MMMinfra.com' beside it (desktop and phone)
findings.fault: The page's one action is dead. 'Write to me' is drawn as a filled button, the address is underlined like a link, and the row has a hover rule, but none of them does anything when clicked. The only working mail link is the small address in the footer at the very bottom of the page.
findings.who_objects: A development-bank officer who decides to contact Mark clicks the button or the address and nothing happens. Getting in touch is the page's whole job (brand sheet §1), so the visitor gives up or thinks the site is broken.

findings.where: First screen, the second filled blue button 'Book a consultation', next to 'Write to me' (desktop and phone)
findings.fault: It is a second primary action with the same filled blue and the same weight as 'Write to me'. It points to #consult, and no consultation section or booking step appears anywhere on the page, so it goes nowhere visible. The visitor sees two equal ways to reach Mark, and the one that works leads nowhere.
findings.who_objects: The visitor who has to pick between two equal buttons and then gets no result. The founder also asked for one direct, personal way to reach Mark, and a booking button with nothing behind it breaks that.

findings.where: First screen, the blue margin notes: 'Istanbul, 2025 / Best Practices in PPP Legislation…', 'Melbourne, 2026 / LLM Course on PPP Law…' and 'São Paulo, 2024 / New Approaches to Risk Allocation…' (desktop and phone)
findings.fault: These notes are static text set in the house blue. The tile's own palette names that blue as the link colour, and each note names a talk or lecture. They look like links to that talk or its slides, but clicking them does nothing.
findings.who_objects: A visitor who wants to check Mark's record clicks a talk title and gets nothing. It looks broken, and they don't know whether the material exists at all.

findings.where: Specimen sections, the blue side labels: 'Palette / Three colours, no accent', 'Type / Newsreader and Public Sans', 'Texture / None', 'Article page / Blog No. 8…', 'Motion / One element enters…', 'Tile notes / For the founder and Mark', and the blue 'MMM INFRA' sample
findings.fault: Static labels in the link blue. Next to the working blue links ('Replay the entrance', the footer address), the same blue now means both 'this is a link' and 'this is a label'.
findings.who_objects: The founder, and later Angélique working from this specimen, can't tell from the colour which blue text is a link. A visitor clicking a section label gets nothing.

findings.fault: The three nav items point to #profile, #articles and #blog, and the page has no section with any of those names, so each click goes nowhere.
findings.who_objects: A visitor who wants Mark's profile or his papers before writing to him uses the nav, the usual way in, and the page does not move.
